g.text: 109 components / 72 nets / 6-layer. Bluetooth-audio vibrator controller: RP2350A + Raspberry Pi RM2 (CYW43439); USB-C, every other lead on back-side pads; BQ24074 charger with power path, a soft power latch (button, GPIO hold, USB), two low-side motor channels, 4 DPS368 barometers on the back (four corners and the centre, a tactile skin) on a switched 3.3 V rail, an IMU and a 1010 RGB status LED. Rails are power symbols; cross-block signals are global labels. Generated from scripts/circuit.py; rebuild with `python3 build.py --only schematic`.

g.desc: 109 components / 72 nets / 6-layer. Bluetooth-audio vibrator controller: RP2350A + Raspberry Pi RM2 (CYW43439); USB-C, every other lead on back-side pads; BQ24074 charger with power path, a soft power latch (button, GPIO hold, USB), two low-side motor channels, 4 DPS368 barometers on the back (four corners and the centre, a tactile skin) on a switched 3.3 V rail, an IMU and a 1010 RGB status LED. Rails are power symbols; cross-block signals are global labels. Generated from scripts/circuit.py; rebuild with `python3 build.py --only schematic`.
